title: Promoting Demand for Locally Grown Produce
what_it_is: Promoting Demand for Locally Grown Produce

sections.label: Local produce logo and e-market
sections.summary: Over 50 farms, distributors and retailers use the logo, and SAFEF partnered Redmart for an e-market with over 100 local produce items.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: To-date, over 50 local farms, distributors and supermarket retailers have successfully applied to use the logo on their produce packaging and marketing collaterals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: In the virtual space, the Singapore Agro-Food Enterprises Federation Limited (SAFEF) has partnered Lazada’s Redmart to launch an e-SG Farmers’ Market page.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: This offers consumers the convenience of choosing over 100 local produce items from 20 local farms at the click of their fingertips.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Later this year, a "Clean and Green" standard for urban farms will be launched.

sections.label: Pilots marketing local produce
sections.summary: Plans were announced to pilot two projects marketing local produce to new mothers' first meal and market patrons.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Arising from their recommendations, we have recently announced plans to work with industry partners and interested members of the Citizen’s Workgroup to pilot two projects targeted at marketing local produce to two key customer groups: new mothers' first meal after delivery and patrons at our markets.

sections.label: 30 by 30 and Lim Chu Kang
sections.summary: The "30 by 30" goal gives the opportunity to relook at creating the agri-food hub in Lim Chu Kang under master planning.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: First of all, the "30 by 30" goal, is precisely to give us this opportunity to relook at how we can create the agri-food hub in Lim Chu Kang as part of the master planning.

sections.label: Poultry waste to biogas
sections.summary: Poultry waste can be recycled to produce biogas, which can provide some energy for farms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: To give you an example, poultry waste can be recycled to produce biogas, which can then provide some energy for the farms.

sections.label: Supporting farm exports and competitiveness
sections.summary: Exporting vegetables and produce lets farms gain economies of scale and lower costs, so agencies will support markets' exports where necessary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: In the coming "30 by 30" plan, we envisage it is likely to be the same.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: However, we do understand that the exporting of vegetables and produce will allow our farms to gain economies of scale, lower their costs and become competitive regional players.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: So, we will work with ESG and the agencies to support our markets to facilitate their exports, where necessary, and to ensure that we do not just have a very vibrant agri-food hub in Singapore, but also a competitive one in the region.
